content.title: Mortgage Rates Near 6%: Current Averages and Outlook for 2026
content.text: April 20, 2026 at 7:41 AM GMT+0 According to data from Yahoo Finance, average national mortgage rates are currently near 6%. The Zillow lender marketplace reports the average 30-year fixed mortgage rate is 6.02%, a decrease from the previous weekend. The average 15-year fixed rate is 5.50%.Current Rate AveragesFor home purchases, the average 30-year fixed rate is 6.02%. The average 20-year fixed rate is 5.84%, while the 15-year fixed average is 5.50%. For adjustable-rate mortgages, the 5/1 ARM averages 6.17% and the 7/1 ARM averages 5.98%. Average rates for VA loans are lower, with the 30-year VA at 5.57% and the 15-year VA at 5.34%.Refinance Rate LandscapeMortgage refinance rates are generally higher than purchase rates. The average 30-year fixed refinance rate is 6.12%. The 20-year fixed refinance averages 6.24%, and the 15-year fixed is 5.57%. For adjustable-rate refinances, the 5/1 ARM averages 6.09% and the 7/1 ARM averages 6.35%. VA refinance rates average 5.48% for a 30-year term and 5.21% for a 15-year term.Long-Term Versus Short-Term FinancingA 30-year mortgage term typically offers a lower monthly payment compared to a shorter term. A 15-year mortgage generally carries a lower interest rate but results in a higher monthly payment. Over the life of a loan, a shorter term can lead to significantly less total interest paid.Fixed and Adjustable Rate StructuresA fixed-rate mortgage locks the interest rate for the loan's entire duration. An adjustable-rate mortgage maintains an initial rate for a set period before it changes periodically. Recently, some fixed rates have begun lower than certain adjustable rates.Securing Favorable TermsLenders typically offer the most favorable rates to applicants with larger down payments, strong credit scores, and low debt-to-income ratios. Improving personal finances is considered a more reliable method for securing a lower rate than waiting for market rates to decline. When evaluating lenders, comparing the annual percentage rate, which includes fees and points, is crucial.Rate OutlookForecasts from earlier in the year anticipated the average 30-year mortgage rate to remain near current levels through the end of the year. 1.
